notes.truth: Stored FP64 coefficients, metric factors and boundary-extended FP64 psi are exact inputs. Fixed D1 uses stored stage omega. Pipeline applies both original stencils in Decimal. Original composed FP64 includes coefficient rounding from sparse assembly.
notes.variants: Center i+1 for interior output i. Use stored CSR order. Restore mu0 and mu1 from 65-digit sums rounded once. Mu1 uses the same FP64 dx as the residual. Slope is the neighbor secant. Preserve existing FP64 wall and outer omega in modified stages. The Taylor variant is identical to centered at k=0.
notes.metrics: Errors subtract in Decimal before rounding each error component for norms. Relative L2 uses the Decimal truth rounded for its norm. Full is all output rows, outer8 the last 8. Curl includes wall and outer rows, unlike D1/D2 interior output.
notes.quantization: Half-ULP envelopes bound independent input rounding perturbations up to measured weights. They are sensitivity diagnostics, not observed input error. Rearranging stencils cannot recover information already lost in stored psi or intermediate omega. The rounded-once diagnostic also rounds its exact D1 result to FP64 for reporting.
notes.scope: Fixed states and operators only. No trajectory, GPU work, timing, or altered discretization.
